rule_text.name: 702.234a
rule_text.rule: Enspirit represents two static abilities, one that functions while the spell with enspirit is on the stack and another that functions both while it's on the stack and while it's on the battlefield. “Enspirit” means “As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may exile a nonenchantment creature you control until this spell is put from the stack into a zone other than the battlefield or the permanent this spell becomes leaves the battlefield” and “If you chose to pay this spell's additional cost, its total cost is reduced by an amount of generic mana equal to the exiled card's mana value.” Paying a spell's enspirit cost follows the rules for paying additional costs in rules 601.2b and 601.2f–h.

rule_text.name: 702.234b
rule_text.rule: The two abilities represented by enspirit are linked. The first ability may also be linked with any number of other abilities printed on the card with enspirit which refer either to “the exiled card” or to cards “exiled with [this object]”. See rule 607, “Linked Abilities.”

rule_text.name: 702.234c
rule_text.rule: You choose which creature to exile as you choose to pay a spell's enspirit cost (see rule 601.2b), and you exile that creature as you pay the total cost (see rule 601.2h).

rule_text.name: 702.234d
rule_text.rule: A creature “becomes enspirited” when it's exiled to pay a spell's enspirit cost. Abilities that trigger when a creature becomes enspirited are leaves-the-battlefield abilities (see rule 603.6c).
